verdict.rationale: The 01 has its own setup documentation: an Introduction page under /setup/ and hardware guides for assembling a device. The server options (Light/Livekit) and clients (desktop, mobile, ESP32) show what a bring-up involves. Nothing shows a quickstart that takes a developer from install to a completed first task. Missing for 10: documented install commands, a step-by-step quickstart flow, evidence of a first completed device task by following the docs alone, and hands-on corroboration that the quickstart works.

support.subject: As a developer, I get from install to a first completed device task using the quickstart docs alone
